supporting_observations.claim: WS-MFISCHER-01 (10.55.10.22) made repeated TCP connections to 10.55.20.30:8080, the inventory-listed explicit web proxy, from 13:35:49 through 14:05:49 UTC. The records label these connections as HTTP to the proxy; they do not show the external destination.

The listed proxy connections recur at roughly five-minute intervals, broadly consistent with the inventory description of LedgerLink's approximately five-minute update checks. The timing alone does not establish that LedgerLink caused these connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied coverage status reports that proxy logs were not collected from 13:20 to 14:15 UTC, overlapping the alerted activity; therefore the proxy request details are unavailable.
The supplied coverage status reports that WS-MFISCHER-01 winsec and Sysmon logs were not collected from 13:20 to 14:15 UTC, so endpoint process attribution for the activity is unavailable.
The available connection records identify the proxy endpoint and HTTP service but do not identify the external hostname or establish that the proxied requests were HTTPS.
claims_not_established: The connection records T235-00091, T235-00120, T235-00130, T235-00202, T235-00227, T235-00235, and T235-00244 do not establish the external destination, requested resource, or actual application-layer protocol.
The available records do not establish whether LedgerLink caused the connections or whether the requests were benign, malicious, successful, or carried data.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy logs for 13:20–14:15 UTC, including CONNECT/request details, destination hostnames, URLs where available, response codes, and user or client attribution.
Obtain endpoint process and network telemetry for WS-MFISCHER-01 around the recorded connection times to identify the initiating process and command line.
If available, obtain TLS/SSL or DNS telemetry that can associate the proxy sessions with their external destinations.
